pages.text: $(l)Pelorovis$() - a buffalo too big for the word, with horns two metres across. Herds of three to five graze the open grass.$(br2)It starts nothing. Strike a healthy one and it turns on you, and the herd comes with it.

Wear it past half its strength and it breaks and runs - and then it is a persistence hunt like any other, with a great deal more at the end: meat, hides, bone, and a large carcass.$(br2)Erectus must bring down one of the megafauna - a Pelorovis, or one of the great predators - to go further.

From erectus, others graze near the water. $(l)Mammuthus$() - the first mammoth, in families of one to three. $(l)Megalotragus$() - a hartebeest the size of a buffalo, with horns swept back. $(l)Rusingoryx$() - a smaller antelope with a hollow dome over its nose, and a honk that carries.

A mammoth or a Megalotragus struck while strong comes for you - but it tells you first: the head comes up, a foot stamps, a trumpet or a snort. Get out of the line. Now and then it does not warn you. After a charge it has to stand and blow; that is when to strike.$(br2)Their hide turns a pointed stick. Bring a $(l)fire-hardened spear$(), a hand axe or a cleaver.

A club will not ring those skulls - it only breaks their bones. Rusingoryx never fights at all: it honks, and the herd goes, and it runs further than anything.$(br2)Stay on the same ground too long and the big herds stop coming - except to a $(l)breeding ground$(), where they come back whatever you do.

$(l)The hunting party.$() $(o)Let's hunt$() lists what is about - prey that runs, animals that fight back, predators, megafauna - and you pick one, how many go and what they carry. For megafauna the party splits: attackers bring the chosen one down, chasers strike another of the herd to draw it off. You pick your group. Nobody starts a hunt near dusk, and a party gives up at nightfall.

$(l)Throwing a spear.$() Hold use with a spear to draw it back; let go to throw. Erectus throws overarm, hard and true; earlier kinds only lob it. In an animal it stays - it goes where the animal goes, and comes free when it is down - and an animal hit while running staggers for a second. Erectus bands throw too: rocks, and a spear when they have something else to fight with.

$(l)Every skill has a level 0$(): flawless. Persistence hunting: at level 1, five more animals run down and you reach it - the animal stays in sight four times in five when it runs, and your blows land a heart and a half harder. Only cows, goats, sheep, pigs and bigger count as game worth running down.
